title: Module budgets (web/pkg/budgets.json)
description: What each wasm module may cost, written by `mise run build:wasm` from each chart's `META.budget` (the family default unless a chart says otherwise) and read by `mise run size`, the budgets test and the benches (REQ-MANIFEST-010, §12). The same object is modules.js's `budgets`. `$defs/budget` is the one budget shape; meta.schema.json and manifest.schema.json refer to it.

propertyNames.description: A module name: a family in a release build, `all` in the debug build.

budget.description: What a chart, and so its module, may cost.

gzip.description: The module's glyphplot_bg.wasm, gzip -9, in bytes; 358400 by default (REQ-SIZE-010).

frameMs.description: The average frame in a native release build, in ms, over the play of REQ-PERF-030; 4 by default.

worstMs.description: The slowest frame over the same play, in ms; 16 by default.

inputMs.description: The average pointer move (hit test, crosshair and readout) over 300 moves at 1,000,000 points, in ms; 0.5 by default (REQ-PERF-050).
